description:
How to actually fix iPhone alarms not going off or alarms going off silently.

There's an apparently long-standing problem countless people have posted about over the years, where the alarms they set on their iPhone simply haven't gone off at all, or they wake up and they're all "going off" but are completely silent. There's a couple most likely reasons for this which I'll discuss, and of course how to fix it. As well as several other possible but less likely reasons.
